name: Spider Vine Darts (CR 7)
body:
Spider Vine Darts

CR 7

XP 3,200

Type mechanical; Perception DC 25; Disable Device DC 25

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset repair

Effect +20 ranged (1d3 plus spider vine poison); multiple targets (all targets in a 20-ft.-square room)

A barrage of tiny darts coated in paralyzing venom sprays the room.
